[with perfect δέδεγμαι [I have received], aorist ἐδεξάμην [I received], and future δέξομαι [I will receive]] The proper meaning of the verb is 'I receive what another gives', and it is said not only of things that can be taken in the hands, but also of people whom one receives and of any things, deeds and words that one person confers upon another.
